motions.name: broken_1
motions.line: Commander! I'll get mad if you do that again! I'm really going to get mad! Teddy, go beat up the Commander for me!

motions.name: broken_2
motions.line: Looks like it's time to write a self-reflection essay.

motions.name: broken_4
motions.line: When can I go back and work with you again, Commander?

motions.name: login
motions.line: Commander... Um, judging by the look on your face, I take it you've finished digesting the combat reports I submitted earlier?

motions.name: touch_1
motions.line: I know I'm still small and I'm not strong enough yet, but I want to do my best to complete the tasks given to me and not leave behind too many regrets.

motions.name: touch_2
motions.line: I'm here! Is everyone present? You mustn't be late!

motions.name: touch_3
motions.line: Hm... The work summary for today is done. There are so many of them stored up. Take a look at this, Commander, as well as these and these and these, they're all going to be precious records in the future!

motions.name: touch_5
motions.line: I will bring you the best outcome.

motions.name: wedding
motions.line: Commander, Teddy and I like you very much. <> Do you want to be with us for always? <> Then hold my hand tight and don't get lost.

motions.name: wedding_touch
motions.line: Being surrounded by teddy bears of all shapes and sizes and being by your side is like a fairytale, Commander. ...No, how could I let myself get distracted? Pull yourself together, RPK-203, we still have work to do!
